description: Source code for a web scraper class 'SpisBedre' that extracts recipe data from spisbedre.dk, including ingredients, instructions, equipment, nutrients, and metadata.

classes.name: SpisBedre
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe data from spisbedre.dk, inheriting from AbstractScraper.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the scraper and loads recipe JSON data from the webpage.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the hostname 'spisbedre.dk' for this scraper.

methods.name: total_time
methods.description: Returns total cooking time from schema.

methods.name: yields
methods.description: Returns the number of servings and unit.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Returns a list of all ingredients.

methods.name: ingredient_groups
methods.description: Returns ingredient groups with formatted ingredients.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Returns recipe instructions as a string.

methods.name: equipment
methods.description: Returns equipment list used in the recipe.
